id: 347
status: Fixed
summary: Numbers and quoted property names reject for get and set properties.
labels: ['Type-Defect', 'Priority-Medium', 'ES5']
stars: 1
commentCount: 5
Comment 0 (2011-02-17): - Use --language_in=ECMASCRIPT5. - Note that these definitions cause parse errors: var x = { get 'x'() { return 1 } }; var x = { get 1() { return 1 } }; ES5 allow these. The Rhino parser needs to be updated.
Comment 3 (2011-03-18): Rhino was patched so these are now accepted. Numbers aren't pass through properly yet.
Comment 4 (2011-04-05): This issue was closed by revision r966.
